Summary

COTRN01C is a CICS online program within the CardDemo application that allows users to view detailed information about a specific credit card transaction by entering a Transaction ID. The program retrieves the transaction record from the TRANSACT file and displays details such as card number, transaction type, category, source, amount, description, timestamps, and merchant information on the screen. It is a main/driver program that manages screen navigation, user input handling, and transaction lookup.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM/CICS File (TRANSACT) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Session Validation - Verify that a valid communication area exists when the program starts; if no session data is present, redirect the user to the sign-on screen to establish a valid session 2: Pre-Selected Transaction Auto-Load - On first entry to the screen, check if a transaction ID was pre-selected and passed from a previous screen (transaction list); if so, automatically trigger the transaction lookup without requiring manual entry 3: Transaction View Screen Initialization - On first entry, initialize the transaction view screen with empty fields and set the cursor focus to the Transaction ID input field, then display the screen to the user 4: User Input Capture - Receive and capture the data entered by the user on the transaction view screen, including the Transaction ID input field 5: Transaction ID Validation - Validate that the Transaction ID field is not empty or blank before attempting a lookup; if empty, display an error message 'Tran ID can NOT be empty...' and return cursor to the Transaction ID field 6: Transaction Record Lookup - Search the TRANSACT file using the entered Transaction ID to retrieve the full transaction record; if the transaction is not found, display error message 'Transaction ID NOT found...' 7: Transaction Details Display - Upon successful retrieval, populate and display all transaction details on the screen including: Transaction ID, Card Number, Transaction Type Code, Category Code, Source, Amount, Description, Original Timestamp, Processing Timestamp, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, and Merchant ZIP code 8: Transaction Amount Formatting - Format the transaction amount with sign and decimal notation before displaying it on the screen 9: Navigate Back to Previous Screen - When the user presses PF3, navigate back to the calling program (the program that launched this screen); if no calling program is recorded, default navigation goes to the main menu screen (COMEN01C) 10: Navigate to Transaction List Screen - When the user presses PF5, navigate to the Transaction List screen (COTRN00C) to allow the user to browse and select transactions 11: Clear Screen Fields - When the user presses PF4, clear all transaction detail fields on the screen and reset the form to its initial empty state, ready for a new transaction ID entry 12: Invalid Key Handling - When the user presses an unrecognized key, display an invalid key error message on the screen without changing the current screen data 13: Screen Header Population - Populate the screen header with application title, program name, transaction ID, current date, and current time before displaying the screen to the user

1. SCREEN INITIALIZATION (First Entry): - When EIBCALEN = 0, redirects to sign-on screen (COSGN00C). - On first entry (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER), initializes the screen with LOW-VALUES and sets cursor to TRNIDINL. - If a transaction was pre-selected (CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED), it is moved to TRNIDINI and PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is performed automatically. ```cobol MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COTRN1AO MOVE -1 TO TRNIDINL OF COTRN1AI IF CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED TO TRNIDINI OF COTRN1AI PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY END-IF PERFORM SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN ``` 2. RECEIVING SCREEN INPUT (RECEIVE-TRNVIEW-SCREEN): - Receives user input from the BMS map COTRN1A into COTRN1AI. ```cobol RECEIVE-TRNVIEW-SCREEN. EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('COTRN1A') MAPSET('COTRN01') INTO(COTRN1AI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC. ``` 3. SENDING SCREEN OUTPUT (SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN): - Populates header info and sends the BMS map COTRN1A to the terminal. - Moves WS-MESSAGE to ERRMSGO for error/info display. ```cobol SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN. PERFORM POPULATE-HEADER-INFO MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COTRN1AO EXEC CICS SEND MAP('COTRN1A') MAPSET('COTRN01') FROM(COTRN1AO) ERASE CURSOR END-EXEC. ``` 4. POPULATING HEADER FIELDS (POPULATE-HEADER-INFO): - Populates TITLE01O, TITLE02O, TRNNAMEO, PGMNAMEO, CURDATEO, CURTIMEO. ```cobol POPULATE-HEADER-INFO. MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE CCDA-TITLE01 TO TITLE01O OF COTRN1AO MOVE CCDA-TITLE02 TO TITLE02O OF COTRN1AO MOVE WS-TRANID TO TRNNAMEO OF COTRN1AO MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO PGMNAMEO OF COTRN1AO MOVE WS-CURDATE-MONTH TO WS-CURDATE-MM MOVE WS-CURDATE-DAY TO WS-CURDATE-DD MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) TO WS-CURDATE-YY MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY TO CURDATEO OF COTRN1AO MOVE WS-CURTIME-HOURS TO WS-CURTIME-HH MOVE WS-CURTIME-MINUTE TO WS-CURTIME-MM MOVE WS-CURTIME-SECOND TO WS-CURTIME-SS MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS TO CURTIMEO OF COTRN1AO. ``` 5. PROCESSING ENTER KEY (PROCESS-ENTER-KEY): - Validates that TRNIDINI is not empty; if empty, sets error flag and sends error message. - Clears all transaction detail fields on screen. - Moves TRNIDINI to TRAN-ID and calls READ-TRANSACT-FILE. - On successful read, populates all transaction detail fields on screen. ```cobol PROCESS-ENTER-KEY. EVALUATE TRUE WHEN TRNIDINI OF COTRN1AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'Tran ID can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO TRNIDINL OF COTRN1AI PERFORM SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE -1 TO TRNIDINL OF COTRN1AI CONTINUE END-EVALUATE IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON MOVE SPACES TO TRNIDI OF COTRN1AI CARDNUMI OF COTRN1AI TTYPCDI OF COTRN1AI TCATCDI OF COTRN1AI TRNSRCI OF COTRN1AI TRNAMTI OF COTRN1AI TDESCI OF COTRN1AI TORIGDTI OF COTRN1AI TPROCDTI OF COTRN1AI MIDI OF COTRN1AI MNAMEI OF COTRN1AI MCITYI OF COTRN1AI MZIPI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRNIDINI OF COTRN1AI TO TRAN-ID PERFORM READ-TRANSACT-FILE END-IF. IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON MOVE TRAN-AMT TO WS-TRAN-AMT MOVE TRAN-ID TO TRNIDI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRAN-CARD-NUM TO CARDNUMI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRAN-TYPE-CD TO TTYPCDI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRAN-CAT-CD TO TCATCDI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRAN-SOURCE TO TRNSRCI OF COTRN1AI MOVE WS-TRAN-AMT TO TRNAMTI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRAN-DESC TO TDESCI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRAN-ORIG-TS TO TORIGDTI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRAN-PROC-TS TO TPROCDTI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRAN-MERCHANT-ID TO MIDI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME TO MNAMEI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY TO MCITYI OF COTRN1AI MOVE TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP TO MZIPI OF COTRN1AI PERFORM SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN END-IF. ``` 6. CLEAR SCREEN (CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN / INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS): - Triggered by PF4. Clears all input and output fields and refreshes the screen. ```cobol INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS. MOVE -1 TO TRNIDINL OF COTRN1AI MOVE SPACES TO TRNIDINI OF COTRN1AI TRNIDI OF COTRN1AI CARDNUMI OF COTRN1AI TTYPCDI OF COTRN1AI TCATCDI OF COTRN1AI TRNSRCI OF COTRN1AI TRNAMTI OF COTRN1AI TDESCI OF COTRN1AI TORIGDTI OF COTRN1AI TPROCDTI OF COTRN1AI MIDI OF COTRN1AI MNAMEI OF COTRN1AI MCITYI OF COTRN1AI MZIPI OF COTRN1AI WS-MESSAGE. ``` 7. KEY HANDLING SUMMARY: - ENTER → PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: Fetches transaction details from TRANSACT file. - PF3 → RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN: Returns to calling program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) or COMEN01C. - PF4 → CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN: Clears all fields and refreshes screen. - PF5 → RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN with COTRN00C: Navigates to Browse Transactions screen. - OTHER → Displays "Invalid key pressed" error message on ERRMSGO. ```cobol EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN DFHENTER PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY WHEN DFHPF3 IF CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'COMEN01C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM ELSE MOVE CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM END-IF PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN WHEN DFHPF4 PERFORM CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN WHEN DFHPF5 MOVE 'COTRN00C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN END-EVALUATE ```
